_source: The OpenAB gateway's own replies to raw slash commands over ACP (one agent_message_chunk, then stopReason end_turn). `modelsNoOptions` was recorded from a real gateway (openab 0.5.4, ws://127.0.0.1:8080/acp, a fresh session/new then session/prompt "/models", 2026-10-22); the others are built exactly as openab-core src/gateway.rs builds them (handle_config_command: "🔧 Available {label}s:", "  {i}. {name}{ ✅}", "\nUsage: /{label} set <number or name>" joined by \n; "✅ Switched to **{name}**"; the /reset and /cancel strings). The model names are examples. The four /reset answers were checked against openab main dabc2fc (crates/openab-core/src/gateway.rs, match (reset_session, dropped)) on 2026-10-22.
modelsNoOptions: ⚠️ No model options available. Start a conversation first.
modelsList:
🔧 Available models:
  1. Default (recommended)
  2. Opus ✅
  3. Sonnet
  4. Haiku
  5. Opus (1M context)

Usage: /model set <number or name>
modelSetFailed: ❌ Failed to switch: session not found
resetOk: 🔄 Session reset. Start a new conversation!
resetDropped: 🔄 Session reset. Dropped 2 buffered message(s). Start a new conversation!
resetNoSessionDropped: 🔄 Dropped 2 buffered message(s). No active session to reset.
